result.reason: The clause includes the preferred CGL, E&O, and cyber limits and certificates on request, but omits workers’ compensation coverage as required by law, so it does not fully reach the playbook position. The added one-year post-termination coverage obligation is not required by the playbook and is potentially ill-suited to occurrence-based CGL coverage. The existing compliance and support obligations remain substantively intact, although relocating the compliance clause under the Technical Support Services article is structurally awkward.
